60% health check trượt → load balancer t: 60% of health checks fail → the load balancer thinks the node is dead → pulls it out → the remaining 40% of capacity becomes 0.
60% thanh toán trượt → mất doanh thu thậ: 60% of payments fail → real revenue lost, while still serving 40% of recommendations nobody needs right now.
BỎ CÓ ƯU TIÊN — cùng tổng năng lực, phân: SHED BY PRIORITY — the same total capacity, allocated differently
